resources.string: During a focus session Lumina keeps you with what you set out to do: only Lumina and the apps you allowed in your mode can be opened. Lumina only sees which app is in front and never reads any content. Outside a session it is only used for full-screen reminders and, if you turned on Think break, to show a short task before the apps you picked there.
